18.DSCR:
President of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Age 12.
True to his name, he had an honest, straightforward personality, full of mischievous energy and a love of pranks. By day he was an elementary school student in Midorigaoka Elementary School's Class 6-2, and once school let out (though he often had to leave partway through for work) he led a double life as company president.
He lost his father, the previous president, in a workplace accident, and became the new president so the executives who wanted to close the company would not be left out in the cold. He also inherited Trider, his father's keepsake, and took on sole responsibility for the company's future.
Still an age where he wanted nothing more than to play, he often grew fed up with jobs that came in regardless of his own plans and refused to sortie. But in the end he could never abandon someone in trouble, and his warm-hearted nature always sent him rushing out. His courage was exceptional too, and he faced life-threatening battles against Mecha Robots without flinching.
Trider, his father's keepsake and the company's greatest asset, was his pride and joy. Whenever he passed the park where half of Trider's face peeked out, such as on his way to school, he always called out, 'Looking good today too!'
He kept fighting Mecha Robots on the Moon and on Mars, and finally succeeded in driving off Zakuron, commander of the $$ロボット帝国$$. But even after peace returned, his work as president of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ naturally continued.

proofread.reason: omission: 顔半分 (half of its face) was dropped and 通学途中など ('such as on his way to school') was turned into a fixed 'during his walk to school'

19.DSCR:
Executive Vice President of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Age 64.
Since the president was an elementary school student, $$柿小路$$ served as the company's public face by virtue of being its elder and by his position. He was also the treasurer, forever working an abacus to track expenses and income.
He once took a night shift part-time job after finishing his company duties just to earn money for his children's presents, and struggled with money both at the company and at home.
He was often seen cycling out to fetch $$ワッ太$$ by bicycle whenever a job request came in, showing up without regard for whether $$ワッ太$$ was in the middle of class or out in the mountains.

20.DSCR:
Managing Director and technical officer of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Age 50.
He knew Trider's structure inside and out, an able mechanic who handled everything from routine maintenance to emergency field repairs.
Stubborn and uncompromising with a craftsman's serious temperament, he often served as the check on the executive vice president, who tended to run a little wild despite being the oldest of the group. His unwavering presence was also important within the company as the one who kept the section chief and the younger staff like $$ワッ太$$ in line.
He was surprisingly quick with words too, and was often seen coaxing a reluctant $$ワッ太$$ into heading out on a job, sometimes appealing to his sense of compassion and sometimes scolding him until he was in the mood to go.
Unlike the executive vice president, he was never blessed with children of his own, and had taken in the orphan Ryusuke as his adopted son.

21.DSCR:
Sales section chief of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Age 25.
A loud, careless, scatterbrained man who had all three qualities of a shallow, easygoing type.
Fond of flash and always saying 'Let's live it up!', he was forever finding excuses - company trips, banquets, anything - to push for a big blowout. Each time, he earned a glare from the executive vice president, who had to scramble to cover the cost.
By title he was supposed to handle contact with clients and develop new business, but at $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, where fighting off Mecha Robots had become the main line of work, he was almost never seen doing any job outside of combat. On the rare occasions he did take action, it amounted to little but complaints and failures, leaving a poor impression.
For all his shortcomings, his natural cheerfulness made him the group's mood-maker. Being the closest in age among the company's adult men, he was, to $$ワッ太$$, an inept but likable older brother figure.

22.DSCR:
Office and accounting staff of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Age 19.
As the only female employee, she was something of the company's mascot - beautiful, intelligent, cheerful, kind, and a good cook.
Since the executive vice president handled nearly all the accounting himself, her main duties were chores like making tea and answering the phone. Beyond that, though, her responsibilities were extremely wide-ranging, from announcing Trider's launches to preparing light meals aboard the shuttle to standing in for $$ワッ太$$'s parents at school observation days.
$$郁絵$$ always handled things flawlessly, but when she got word that her grandfather had been hospitalized, even she began to make noticeable mistakes. Unable to cover the high hospital costs, she was troubled at heart, yet still put on a brave face so as not to worry everyone else.

23.DSCR:
Homeroom teacher of Midorigaoka Elementary School's Class 6-2. Age 28.
She kept Class 6-2, full of distinctive students including $$ワッ太$$, well in hand, and was well liked by them in turn.
She understood the delicate position $$ワッ太$$ was in as both president and elementary schooler, and though worried, always kindly sent him off to work.
The teacher of the neighboring class, Mr. $$大門$$, had taken a liking to her, but she seemed to pay it little mind.

24.DSCR:
Homeroom teacher of Midorigaoka Elementary School's Class 6-1. Age 28.
Noticeably stricter than Ms. $$美重子$$, he did not look kindly on the fact that $$ワッ太$$, an elementary schooler, was also working. In time, though, he came to acknowledge $$ワッ太$$, who ran himself ragged for the sake of the world, other people, and his own employees.
Though he was in charge of the neighboring class, he frequently showed up in $$ワッ太$$'s classroom to lay down the law over $$ワッ太$$'s repeated tardiness and disruptions. It seemed this was also largely because he was head over heels for Ms. $$美重子$$, and wanted to see her and show off his good side.

25.DSCR:
$$ワッ太$$'s classmate and the class idol he adored.
With her cute looks, excellent grades, and good personality, she was popular with boys and girls alike.
$$ワッ太$$'s rival Kenichi was also always eager to catch her attention, but $$かおる$$ herself treated everyone the same without favoritism.
After $$ワッ太$$ won the final battle against the $$ロボット帝国$$, though, she showed him a warmth she never had before.

26.DSCR:
$$ワッ太$$'s mother. Age 43.
Though she lost her husband in an accident, she raised her three children admirably. She worked as head of the nursery school next to the Takeo household, a formidable mother who made no compromises in housework, her job, or her children's upbringing.
Having known the $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ staff since her late husband's days as president, she seemed to keep up a close relationship with them. Perhaps because they were both women, she was especially friendly with $$郁絵$$.

proofread.reason: omission: the Japanese hedges twice (親しく交流している模様 'it seems'; 女性同士という事もあってか 'perhaps because they are both women'); both hedges were dropped, turning a guess into a statement

27.DSCR:
$$ワッ太$$'s younger sister. Age 8.
An energetic tomboy, but also a bright, honest girl.
She was the most level-headed member of the Takeo household after $$加代$$, sometimes teaching $$ワッ太$$ table manners before he went off to a party, other times waking him when he overslept and was about to be late.
She never went so far as to fight, but she did once pilot Trider.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 'in it' has no antecedent before Trider is named; 戦闘まではしなかった is 'did not go as far as fighting'

28.DSCR:
$$ワッ太$$'s younger brother. Age 5.
A quiet boy compared to the overflowing energy of $$ワッ太$$ and his sister $$サチ子$$.
Devoted to his big sister, he was always tagging along wherever $$サチ子$$ went.

34.DSCR:
A world authority on robotics and aerospace engineering.
Strong in his sense of justice and responsibility, he was an admirable man both as a scientist and as a person. He carried on the will of his late friend Dr. $$金田$$ and completed $$鉄人$$ No. 28.
He went on to maintain $$鉄人$$ and built the servant robot $$０８$$ and the air car Clipper that $$正太郎$$ rode, while also supporting $$正太郎$$ in various ways, from drawing up strategies in battles against villains to seeing through an enemy's weaknesses. He also had the full trust of Inspector $$大塚$$, who always came to him for advice whenever a robot-related crime occurred. His very brilliance, though, also made him a target for enemies on several occasions.
He valued not only his work but also family life, and treated the parentless $$正太郎$$ much like a father would. After being entrusted with Black Ox by Dr. $$不乱拳$$, he looked after it well too, patiently and carefully teaching it things like how to move its body.
He was also extremely well-connected, and was acquainted with nearly every scientist who appeared over the course of the story.

39.DSCR:
A psychic born on planet $$ギシン星$$ and raised on Earth. His real name is Mars. Age 17.
As a young child, he was sent to Earth from planet $$ギシン星$$ along with the Six God Robos, including $$ガイヤー$$. When he was taken in by the Myojin couple on Earth, he was given the name $$タケル$$.
Until the invasion from planet $$ギシン星$$ began, he served as gunner aboard the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ as a member of the $$クラッシャー隊$$.
A super A-class psychic, he wielded a wide range of powers: telepathy that let him communicate with others at a distance, psychokinesis that let him fire his own hair like needles, precognition to sense danger, and an acceleration ability to move at superhuman speed. These powers proved a great asset not only in direct combat with enemy psychics but also in saving lives.
His formidable powers and the secret of his birth, however, left him isolated from his comrades in the $$クラッシャー隊$$ for a time.
He was also seen more than once running off on his own, driven by his sense of responsibility and duty without listening to those around him, but at heart he was honest and kind. Through his battles he awakened to his true calling, and came to fight for the peace not only of Earth but of the whole universe.
Through his reunion with and parting from his real brother $$マーグ$$, and his confrontation and eventual reconciliation with the hostile psychic $$ロゼ$$, he finally achieved the defeat of Emperor $$ズール$$, who had been reaching his malevolent hand toward Earth.
When $$ズール$$ later returned, $$タケル$$ was tormented by the Devil Ring, which ate away at his life every time he used his psychic powers. But with help from $$マーグ$$ and $$ロゼ$$, he defeated $$ズール$$ once more.
Afterward, he and $$ロゼ$$ joined hands and set off together for the galaxy.

40.DSCR:
Captain of the $$クラッシャー隊$$, a special unit under the direct command of Director $$大塚$$. Age 24.
Calm and unshaken at all times, he was deeply trusted by Director $$大塚$$ and his fellow team members. He fully understood the weight of his position as captain, and had an exceptionally strong sense of responsibility.
In the war with planet $$ギシン星$$, he took charge of combat command in the field, and the $$クラッシャー隊$$ fought according to his orders.
He later became commander of Space Station Ceres, broadening the scope of his activities.

41.DSCR:
A member of the $$クラッシャー隊$$. Age 17.
Something of a cynic whose blunt words often led to misunderstandings, he was at heart a kind man who cared deeply for his friends.
He served as gunner aboard the $$コスモクラッシャー$$, and was often seen peering through his scope and firing his laser with his catchphrase, 'How impudent!' during battle.
He had seen $$タケル$$ as a rival ever since they shared gunnery duty, and treated him harder than anyone once he learned of $$タケル$$'s origins. But after coming to understand $$タケル$$'s true heart and reconciling with him, he rebuilt their bond of trust.
When $$ズール$$ returned, he tried to sacrifice himself to aid $$タケル$$, but was saved by the Rose Knight.

42.DSCR:
A member of the $$クラッシャー隊$$. Age 16.
Easygoing by nature, but despite his stocky build, his movements are agile, and he has a delicate sensibility.
He serves as pilot of the $$コスモクラッシャー$$, and his skill is considerable. He also has deep knowledge of machinery.
Good-natured and weak to a pretty face, he once gave $$ロゼ$$, disguised for an infiltration mission, a tour of Battle Camp without a shred of suspicion.

43.DSCR:
The sole woman of the $$クラッシャー隊$$. Age 15.
Though still young enough to be called a girl, she was an expert in communications and information analysis.
Caring by nature, she always looked out for $$タケル$$, who tended to be isolated because of his upbringing, and often stepped in to support him.

44.DSCR:
A woman warrior tasked with policing the psychics of planet $$ギシン星$$.
Recognized for her powerful psychic abilities and loyalty to $$ズール$$, she became one of Wahl's direct subordinates.
She was assigned as adjutant to the mind-controlled $$マーグ$$, but her post doubled as that of his watcher.
After $$マーグ$$, whom she had regarded only as someone to watch, saved her life, the compassion and kindness she had sealed deep in her heart began to surface. That respite was brief, though, as $$マーグ$$'s death made conflict with $$タケル$$ unavoidable. Yet through their battles she came to know $$タケル$$'s heart, and after experiencing the kindness of his adoptive mother $$静子$$ and reuniting with her younger sister Rui, she finally resolved to leave $$ズール$$'s side.
From then on, she volunteered to join the $$クラッシャー隊$$, and became a great force in the fight to defeat $$ズール$$.
For a time she returned to planet $$ギシン星$$, but when $$ズール$$ made his return, she visited Earth to sound the alarm. There, she learned the secret of $$タケル$$'s suffering under the Devil Ring, and continued to worry for him ever since.
In the true final battle with $$ズール$$ on Earth, she confessed her love to a suffering $$タケル$$ and offered up her prayers.
After $$ズール$$ fell, she and $$タケル$$ joined hands and set off together for the galaxy.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says 妹のルイ (Roze's younger sister, brief: 'has a younger sister Rui'), not Takeru's sister; 'his sister' wrongly gave Takeru a sister

47.DSCR:
The youngest member of the $$クラッシャー隊$$. Age 10.
Having lost both his parents to a $$ギシン星$$ attack, he asked to enlist in order to avenge them. He initially joined Battle Camp working in the mess hall, through his connection with $$タケル$$. Later, when the team headed into space, he went so far as to board the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ in place of $$タケル$$, who fought aboard $$ガイヤー$$.
Despite his unfortunate circumstances, his personality was extremely bright and positive. He tended to speak his mind the moment she thought it, which often led to inappropriate remarks, but his natural cheer and likability made him the team's mascot, easing the mood wherever he went.
He later began showing signs of psychic ability.

proofread.reason: pronoun: researched gender is male (少年 who admires Takeru) but the English used she/her throughout; also addition: 'of her own' is not in 後に超能力者としての兆しを見せた

48.DSCR:
Director of the Earth Defense Force. Age 42.
He organized the $$クラッシャー隊$$ to protect humanity's advance into space and swiftly resolve incidents that occurred there.
Ordinarily mild-mannered, he carried a dignified presence when directing battles or issuing orders to the $$クラッシャー隊$$.
He was an old friend of Dr. Myojin, and one of the few people who knew the secret of $$タケル$$'s birth.

49.DSCR:
$$タケル$$'s adoptive mother. Age 42.
She possessed a kindness that made no distinctions between people, and a beauty that belied her age.
She supported $$タケル$$, tossed about by a harsh fate, with a mother's love, and her presence had a great influence on his fight.
After losing her husband to a $$ギシン星$$ attack, she moved to Battle Camp through Director $$大塚$$'s arrangement. From then on, she became a mother figure to the entire $$クラッシャー隊$$.

50.DSCR:
$$タケル$$'s identical twin older brother. Age 17.
He was separated from his brother soon after birth, his father was executed, and he even lost his mother at age 10. Upon learning that $$ズール$$ was behind all of it, he resolved on revenge.
Feigning a loss of sanity to get close to $$ズール$$, he resisted him through an information war, telepathically passing the secret of $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and news of attacks from planet $$ギシン星$$ to $$タケル$$.
Eventually, when Wahl and Sagoul exposed his activities, a bomb was planted on him and he was forced into battle against $$タケル$$. Seizing an opening to break free, he finally reunited with $$タケル$$ and succeeded in passing on their memories of their late parents. But just when it seemed the brothers could finally fight side by side, he was captured by $$ズール$$ and placed under mind control. Forced into a fratricidal battle he never wanted, $$マーグ$$ regained his memories after taking a hard blow to the head in the fighting. This time the brothers truly seemed able to join hands, but $$マーグ$$ stepped in front of a combat mecha to stop $$ロゼ$$, who kept attacking, and was struck by its beam.
He closed out his short life at his brother's side, having never been able to fight alongside him to the end. Yet his resolve to fight for the peace of the universe was carried on by $$タケル$$.
When $$ズール$$ returned, $$マーグ$$ kept cheering $$タケル$$ on from the world of the dead. At times he borrowed $$ロゼ$$'s body to become the $$バラの騎士$$, offering direct support as well, supporting his beloved brother even in death.

proofread.reason: addition: the Japanese says 父は処刑され (his father was executed); 'he saw his father executed' adds an eyewitness claim the text does not make

65.DSCR:
A young man in a world sealed within the $$相克界$$, who came to be called the $$特異点$$. 19 years old.
A hot-blooded, straightforward young man who seems like the typical hero type at first glance, but is at heart a shallow, incorrigible womanizer. Even in the world before the spacetime chaos, he carried on with countless women, and in particular kept up trysts with $$ティナ$$, one of his girlfriends, whenever he could steal time away from military duty.
After being transferred to the world 20 years later, he was rescued by the $$ファクトリー$$ caravan of $$エマーン$$, led by $$シャイア$$, and told that he was the $$特異点$$. Learning that he was the cause of the world's chaos and that his own existence was needed to repair it, he resolved to travel with the $$ファクトリー$$.
Though he mainly courted $$ミムジィ$$, he would make passes at any woman he saw on his travels, repeatedly causing trouble because of it.
He has a natural talent for piloting, having mastered the inertial control system, a technology unknown to him, after only a little practice once it was explained to him. He drove back the $$チラム$$ forces, who sought to seize the $$特異点$$ by targeting the Groma, time and again while piloting the $$オーガス$$.
Eventually he crosses paths with $$オルソン$$, another $$特異点$$, and $$アテナ$$, the daughter born to him and $$ティナ$$. They were hostile toward one another at first because of their positions, but gradually came to join hands and deepen their bond.
In the end, together with $$オルソン$$, he plunged into the $$大特異点$$, once a $$時空震動弾$$, and met their past selves within it. This spacetime chaos had occurred because the other personalities of $$桂$$ and $$オルソン$$ existed within the same time. To undo the chaos, the two of them pulled the trigger on their own past selves.
Among the infinite possible futures shown in the epilogue was a glimpse of him holding a child born to him and $$ミムジィ$$.

proofread.reason: omission: 恋人の１人であるティナ = Tina, one of his lovers (English made her the girlfriend); referent: 'The two' left out one of the three (Kei, Olson, Athena) who were hostile at first; mistranslation: 桂とオルソンのもう１つの人格 = the other personalities of Kei and Olson, not one personality 'shared by' them

66.DSCR:
A young man in a world sealed within the $$相克界$$, who came to be called the other $$特異点$$.
He was born the same year as $$桂$$, but because he appeared in the chaotic era five years earlier than $$桂$$, he is five years older, at 25.
When he appeared in the chaotic era, he was taken in by General $$マイケル$$ Henderson of the $$チラム$$ forces. Through that connection, he met the general's beloved daughter $$ティナ$$, and likewise his granddaughter $$アテナ$$. After $$ティナ$$ and $$マイケル$$ were killed in an attack by the Mu, he became $$アテナ$$'s guardian and teacher, supporting her both publicly and privately.
Recognized both as a $$特異点$$, a figure of great importance, and for his accomplishments before the chaotic era, he was given the exceptional rank of Special Major General in the $$チラム$$ forces. He was at odds with $$桂$$ at first, but once $$チラム$$ began pushing a spacetime repair plan that did not use the Singularities, he left the army and returned to being a comrade fighting for the same goal.
In the end, he plunged into the $$大特異点$$ together with $$桂$$, and confronted his past self. He pulled the trigger to bring the chaos to an end.
Among the infinite possible futures shown in the epilogue was a glimpse of him sharing a kiss with $$アテナ$$.

67.DSCR:
A humanoid made by the Mu.
Outwardly indistinguishable from a human girl, she was displayed for sale in Atlantis after being swept up and carried off in a spacetime transfer. $$桂$$ bought her there, and she became a member of the Groma.
Because she was designed to become friends with humans, she has emotional circuits equivalent to a human's. Because of this, she came in time to fall in love with $$桂$$, her own benefactor.
Having been built for nursing and repair work, she handled everything from everyday chores to mechanical maintenance.
During the final battle with the Mu, she drove off the enemy by diverting her own energy into the Dimora's main cannon to save $$ミムジィ$$. But by the time $$桂$$ rushed to her side, she had already used up all her energy, and she closed her eyes in his arms. She then vanished into the depths of space, seen off by $$桂$$'s tears.

72.DSCR:
A $$ニュータイプ$$ boy who joins the $$エゥーゴ$$, and the pilot of the $$Ｚガンダム$$. 17 years old.
Originally an ordinary, somewhat sensitive boy attending high school on the space colony 'Green Noa.' He has a complex about his feminine-sounding name, $$カミーユ$$, and threw himself into masculine pursuits like homo avis (a simple glider) and karate. With both parents technical officers in the $$連邦軍$$, he grew up well versed in mechanics, skilled enough to win the Jr. Mobile Suit tournament.
However, after Jerid mocked his name and the resulting friction with him put $$カミーユ$$ at odds with the $$ティターンズ$$, he ended up helping $$クワトロ$$ and the others steal the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, and joined the $$エゥーゴ$$ as a result.
He awakened to his abilities as a $$ニュータイプ$$ in the course of battle, and gradually became an ace pilot for the $$エゥーゴ$$.
At first he simply fought out of resentment toward the $$ティターンズ$$, but through his encounters and partings with adults like $$クワトロ$$ and $$アムロ$$, and with women like $$フォウ$$ and Rosamia, he grew tremendously as a person. As he searched for a way to end the war, he expanded his own consciousness out into space.
At the end of the TV series, $$シロッコ$$ dragged his mind down with him, leaving $$カミーユ$$ with a deep wound in his heart, but at the end of the film version he shakes it off, and he and $$ファ$$ confirm each other's safety in each other's arms.

73.DSCR:
$$カミーユ$$'s childhood friend. 17 years old.
Because she and her parents were known to be acquainted with $$カミーユ$$ after his theft of the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, they were captured by Bask. After being rescued by $$ブライト$$, she joined the $$エゥーゴ$$ and volunteered as a pilot, both out of defiance toward the $$ティターンズ$$ and to stay by $$カミーユ$$'s side. Though troubled by her own lack of skill, she fought through the entire $$グリプス戦役$$.
She has a nurturing, fussing personality, and had long kept after $$カミーユ$$ about his lifestyle and habits. $$カミーユ$$ apparently found her nagging tiresome, if only inwardly. Perhaps because of this personality, she also ended up in charge of looking after the orphans Shinta and Qum, whom $$クワトロ$$ brought aboard the $$アーガマ$$.
In the TV series, when her beloved $$カミーユ$$ suffered a mental breakdown during the final battle, she left the battlefield to devote herself to caring for and nursing him. In the film version, however, the two are seen rejoicing together in each other's safety.

74.DSCR:
An Enhanced Human trained at the Murasame Research Institute, and the pilot of the Psycho $$ガンダム$$. Her nominal rank is Ensign.
She is normally cheerful and lively, but riding the Psycho $$ガンダム$$ exposes her to mind control waves, transforming her into a violent personality accompanied by intense headaches.
She has lost her past memories, and this loss has become a psychological wound that binds her tightly. Even the name $$フォウ$$ is not her real name, but simply what she is called as the fourth test subject at the Murasame Research Institute. Still, believing the claim that defeating the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$ would restore her memories, she endured the headaches and fought on in the Psycho $$ガンダム$$.
Meeting $$カミーユ$$ lets her feel the warmth of the human heart, but she later learns that he is the pilot of the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, and this troubles her greatly.
In both the TV series and the film version, she throws off her psychological chains, throws herself in harm's way for $$カミーユ$$'s sake, and loses her life amid the flames of battle.

75.DSCR:
A pilot originally in the $$ティターンズ$$. She defected to the $$エゥーゴ$$ after witnessing one of Bask's despicable schemes firsthand. Her rank is Lieutenant.
Her high piloting skill was valued by the $$エゥーゴ$$ as well, and she was entrusted with mainstay units like the Rick Dias, the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, and the Super $$ガンダム$$, all of which she handled with ease.
She has a strong will to act on her own convictions, and a soldier's severity. At the same time, she also has a feminine gentleness, shown in the way she looked out for the younger $$カミーユ$$ and $$カツ$$. She always kept Henken at arm's length whenever he approached her, but she does not seem to have been entirely indifferent to him.
In the final battle against the $$ティターンズ$$, after her immobilized unit was left drifting following Reccoa's downing, she stepped outside and was struck all over by debris from Yazan's bombardment. She entrusted the rest to $$カミーユ$$ when he rushed to her side, and breathed her last in his arms.

76.DSCR:
A boy soldier who joins the $$エゥーゴ$$.
Because he had boarded the $$ホワイトベース$$ as a refugee during the $$一年戦争$$, he was raised after the war as the adopted son of the married couple $$隼人$$ and Frau. But when he and his family visited $$アムロ$$, he volunteered to join the $$エゥーゴ$$ himself, and joined up with the $$アウドムラ$$ alongside $$アムロ$$.
A far cry from his quiet early childhood, he has grown reckless and hot-blooded. He holds a rivalry with $$カミーユ$$, who is his age, and has gone as far as sortieing without orders and ignoring commands.
He falls for Sarah, one of $$シロッコ$$'s subordinates whom he meets on the battlefield, and tries to persuade her to leave $$シロッコ$$'s side. But she does not accept his words, and dies protecting $$シロッコ$$ instead.
In the final battle against the $$ティターンズ$$, he distinguishes himself by saving $$エマ$$ from a tight spot. But while fleeing from Yazan, he collides with a meteorite and is scattered into space.

proofread.reason: referent: 彼の下から離れさせよう = leave Scirocco's side; the English 'leave him' reads as leaving Katz, the opposite direction

77.DSCR:
A member of $$カラバ$$, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s support organization.
An active woman, but her habit of speaking her mind the moment she thinks it often earned her the resentment of those around her.
When she made contact with the $$アウドムラ$$, she was delighted to finally meet $$アムロ$$, the hero of the $$一年戦争$$ in whom she had long held an interest. She wasted no time repeatedly making bold advances on him, and eventually came to support an invigorated $$アムロ$$ as his girlfriend.

79.DSCR:
The regent of $$アクシズ$$, a resource asteroid where the remnants of the $$ジオン公国$$'s forces have gathered.
She has installed the 8-year-old $$ミネバ$$, the orphaned daughter of $$ドズル・ザビ$$, as a figurehead, and leads the whole of $$アクシズ$$'s forces as its de facto leader.
Fierce and cold-blooded by nature. Championing the resurgence of $$ジオン$$, she possesses the outstanding political skill that raised $$アクシズ$$, once biding its time as a mere asteroid base, into a major power to rival the $$ティターンズ$$ and the $$エゥーゴ$$.
She is also an exceptionally gifted $$ニュータイプ$$ who pilots her personal unit, the $$キュベレイ$$, displaying overwhelming skill on the battlefield.

A reserve member of the former Getter Team.
When the deuterium missile was dropped on Japan, he fled to an underground shelter together with $$元気$$, and raised her as $$渓$$.
Thirteen years later, while exploring the surface, he encounters the battle between the Tower and the Invaders. He boards $$真ゲッター$$ once to escape the crisis, but withdraws from the front lines afterward due to his injuries.
After Shin Dragon awakens and $$號$$ leaves the front lines, he boards $$真ゲッター$$ together with $$竜馬$$ and $$隼人$$.
After settling things with Professor Saotome, he goes up into space and fights a desperate battle against the Invaders, who seek to seize the entire galaxy.
In the end, he throws himself into a battle in the gap of time that continues for all eternity, and departs for another dimension.

266.DSCR:
A new type of human born from the fusion of Professor Saotome's and $$早乙女ミチル$$'s cells, exposed to Getter rays. He was created to become the pilot of Shin Dragon, but the plan itself ended in failure.
He was missing for thirteen years, but reappears unchanged in order to save $$渓$$. He rides $$真ゲッター$$, fighting primarily to protect her.
He was taciturn and rarely showed emotion outside of combat, but through the fighting he came to connect with $$渓$$ and the others, gradually showing more human feeling.
In the final battle he pilots $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and fights alongside $$竜馬$$ and the rest of the Getter Team. In the end, he sends off $$竜馬$$ and the others as they depart for a battle that continues for all eternity.

268.DSCR:
A young man exploring the surface, contaminated by Getter rays, together with $$弁慶$$ and $$渓$$.
He inherited the skill of his father, once a renowned Getter Robo mechanic, and is skilled with machinery.
He has a gentle personality that dislikes conflict, but also has a side to him that becomes unstoppable once he snaps.
While exploring the surface he encounters the battle between the Tower and the Invaders. He is named by $$號$$ to pilot Shin Bear in place of the injured $$弁慶$$.
Though inexperienced, he fights hard and gradually builds up teamwork, but when $$號$$ is rendered unable to fight, he hands $$真ゲッター$$ over to $$竜馬$$ and the others.
Once the fighting moves into space he remains on Earth, but with the cooperation of the Japanese government he goes up into space together with $$渓$$. There he is rescued by the revived $$號$$, piloting $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and boards it.
He fights alongside $$竜馬$$ and the rest of the Getter Team, and in the end sends off $$竜馬$$ and the others as they depart for a battle that continues for all eternity.

276.DSCR:
The pilot of Aphrodite A and its successor unit, $$ビューナスＡ$$.
The daughter of $$弓弥之助$$, director of the Photonic Power Laboratory, she is serious and values cooperation.
She has also shown devotion by risking herself to stop $$甲児$$, who over-relies on Mazinger's power and tries to fight alone.
She and $$甲児$$ are interested in each other, but since both are hopeless when it comes to romance, their relationship remains stuck at more-than-friends, less-than-lovers.
After Aphrodite A is destroyed, she asks the Three Professors to build $$ビューナスＡ$$ modeled after herself. In the final battle, with $$甲児$$ absent, she fights hard to intercept $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$'s forces.

277.DSCR:
A delinquent leader who aims to conquer Japan's students, uniting Japan's alliance of delinquent gang bosses.
Commanding delinquent bosses from across Japan, he marches into Atami, the last holdout. He challenges $$甲児$$, believed to be the local shadow boss, but is defeated, and in the midst of it runs into an attack by $$あしゅら$$'s forces.
Afterward he lodges at $$くろがね屋$$, but is held to account over unpaid lodging fees, and ends up gradually drawn into the fight against $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$.
In the final battle, he plays a huge part, scolding a troubled $$甲児$$ and taking on the Mechanical Beasts in $$ボスボロット$$, a converted work robot.
It is said that even the author does not know his real name.

278.DSCR:
One of $$ボス$$'s henchmen.
Despite his vacant expression and runny nose, which give no hint of it, he is a master of drunken fist boxing with championship-level skill in Japan.
When he made quick work of Iron Mask with that skill, $$甲児$$ said of him and $$ムチャ$$ together that 'they might be stronger than $$ボス$$'.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says Kouji's remark about being stronger than Boss was about Nuke and Mucha together (ムチャと合わせ); the English 'he might be stronger' made it about Nuke alone

279.DSCR:
One of $$ボス$$'s henchmen.
His small stature and obedience to $$ボス$$ make him look like nothing more than a hanger-on at first glance, but he is actually a master of finger-flicking projectiles. He once nailed Iron Mask square in the face with a firecracker pellet faster than the man could level his gun, proof that his skill is the real thing.

proofread.reason: addition: the Japanese only says 実は指弾の名手 (master of shidan, finger-flicked projectiles); 'firecracker pellets' belongs to the next sentence and 'with pinpoint speed' is not in the Japanese

281.DSCR:
Director of the Photon Power Institute.
He once studied under $$甲児$$'s grandfather, $$兜十蔵$$, and worked together with him researching photon power.
Even after $$十蔵$$ disappeared, he continued research toward practical application, holding to the belief that photon power must be used for peace.
In the final battle, faced with the fierce onslaught of Viscount Pygman and his army of Mechanical Beasts, he made the agonizing decision to activate the Scientific Fortress Institute, which actively employed photon energy in combat.

282.DSCR:
One of the Three Doctors of the Photon Power Institute, and an authority on robotics.
True to his energetic-sounding name, he is a vigorous, high-energy person.
All three doctors are old friends of $$十蔵$$'s and call him 'Juzo-chan.'

283.DSCR:
One of the Three Doctors of the Photon Power Institute, and an authority on robotics.
His name gives a slow-moving impression, but his mind works quickly.
Together with the other two doctors, he has developed robots for the Mazinger corps, including Million Alpha, Baion Beta, and Daion Gamma.

284.DSCR:
One of the Three Doctors of the Photon Power Institute, and an authority on robotics.
Together with $$のっそり$$ and $$もりもり$$, he built the Jet Scrander.
All three doctors are quite lecherous, and they idolize $$菊ノ助$$ of the $$くろがね屋$$.

286.DSCR:
One of the Kurogane Five, known as 'An the Weasel.'
He works as the bath attendant at the $$くろがね屋$$, scrubbing guests' backs, but is in truth a bomb specialist.
He has a photon bomb embedded in his own body, and is a fearless man always ready to blow himself up at a moment's notice.
He seems to get along well with $$暗黒寺$$ and $$シロー$$, and the three of them were often seen acting together.

287.DSCR:
Head clerk of the $$くろがね屋$$ and one of the Kurogane Five.
He also serves as the leader of the Five, and is deeply trusted by the proprietress $$つばさ$$.
A cyborg with a head and arms made of Chogokin Z, boasting monstrous strength to rival even a $$機械獣$$.

289.DSCR:
One of the Kurogane Five.
He works as the $$くろがね屋$$'s driver, but his main role is cleaning up the gangsters who gather from all over the country to target them.
His beloved gun, the Super Blackhawk .44 Magnum, can fire up to six rounds of Chogokin Z ammunition. He has also used a freeze rifle to slow down a $$機械獣$$, displaying gunslinging skills befitting his cowboy style.

290.DSCR:
One of the Kurogane Five.
She normally serves as the head maid of the $$くろがね屋$$, and looks like an unremarkable old woman, but she is the strongest of the Five in actual skill. Even $$つばさ$$ holds her in high regard, calling her 'Big Sister $$お菊$$.'
Her weapon of choice is a wire made of Chogokin Z, and her movements are extraordinary; even when $$甲児$$, who had overwhelmed $$ボス$$ in a fight, challenged her with all his strength, he could not lay a single finger on her.

299.DSCR:
Main pilot of $$ダイ・ガード$$. 25 years old.
He belongs to Public Relations Section 2 of the Planning and Development Department at $$２１世紀警備保障$$, where he normally handles desk work and PR activities at events. But the moment a $$ヘテロダイン$$ appears, he boards $$ダイ・ガード$$ and goes into battle to build a peaceful future and protect everyone's happiness.
Ask him what he likes and he will answer 'giant robots!' without hesitation, that is how much he loves them. As a child, watching hero shows on television, he declared he would definitely become a pilot, and he grew up never losing that boyish heart.
In time he entered the International Defense University (National Defense University), attached to the Far East Command of the $$国連$$ Security Force, and earned his Class A license for upright heavy machinery. On the recommendation of his cousin $$神村$$, secretary to the president of $$２１世紀警備保障$$, he joined his current company for the sake of piloting $$ダイ・ガード$$.
He is cheerful, lively, and full of emotion, always the one lifting spirits in the section. His strength lies in his overflowing sense of justice, helping the weak and standing up to the strong, and many people have been moved by his passion. That said, he also tends to get more fired up than necessary, and it is just as true that he often does something reckless and gets scolded for it.
He dislikes green peppers and celery, and retains a childish streak in various ways. His hobbies are jogging to stay in shape and, fittingly for a robot lover, building plastic models. $$いぶき$$ has also mentioned that he buys up huge quantities of toys besides.

300.DSCR:
Navigator of $$ダイ・ガード$$. 20 years old.
She is younger than $$赤木$$ and $$青山$$, but since she joined the company right after graduating high school, she is technically their senior. In fact, she is capable both as an office worker and as a navigator, and with her strong-willed, tomboyish personality, neither $$赤木$$ nor $$青山$$ can get the better of her.
In the past, she lost her beloved real father in an incident involving a $$ヘテロダイン$$, and her mother remarried another man, a doctor. She constantly argues with her stepfather over their differing ways of thinking.
At first, she had not fully overcome the wound of losing her father, and harbored an extraordinary hatred toward the $$ヘテロダイン$$. That was why, like $$赤木$$, she had joined the company hoping to pilot $$ダイ・ガード$$, and her intense desire to avenge her father sometimes led her to act even more recklessly than he did.
As the fighting continued, a $$ヘテロダイン$$ (of the same type) that had caused her real father's death appeared. Losing her composure disrupted her navigation, causing $$赤木$$ and $$青山$$ to be injured, and she lost her confidence. She was further shocked when $$百目鬼$$, a scientist like her father, confronted her with the true meaning behind her father's actions, and in her despair she even tried to quit the company for a time. However, through teamwork with $$赤木$$ and the others she found herself again, and from then on she was able to face the $$ヘテロダイン$$ in her duties with a more honest heart.

301.DSCR:
Engineer of $$ダイ・ガード$$. 25 years old.
After graduating from Hokkaido General Institute of Technology, he joined $$２１世紀警備保障$$. He entered the same section as $$赤木$$ in the same year, but their personalities are polar opposites. As an engineer he has real skill, handling the control and management of $$ダイ・ガード$$'s various systems and drive units flawlessly. However, he seems to have had no interest at all in being an active pilot; his stated motive for joining was that it looked like 'a reasonably relaxed, well-paying, high-profile job.'
At first he showed reluctance to fight the $$ヘテロダイン$$ and even submitted his resignation. But in the end he could not leave his comrades behind and came back, showing that underneath he has a warm, soft-hearted nature.
In his day-to-day work he has a laid-back, individualistic streak, and used to leave for home alone while everyone else worked overtime, which could look self-centered. But this was actually so he could visit his hospitalized mother, revealing both an admirable reluctance to explain himself and a devotion to family.
Good-looking, tall (180 cm), athletic, financially stable, a smooth talker, a strong drinker, and a skilled driver, he possesses nearly every quality that could attract women. In fact, he is quite popular with women both inside and outside the company, and $$中原$$ from the same section has feelings for him too, though at present he does not appear to have a girlfriend.

302.DSCR:
Main pilot of Kokubouger.
He was $$赤木$$'s mentor back in his National Defense University days, serving as a practical skills instructor. Since $$赤木$$'s student days he has called him 'Akaten' (failing grade), and even now treats him as if he were still his underachieving student.
Being older, he shows no flashiness, but his skill, backed by experience, is genuine. He has repeatedly demonstrated high ability in many respects: always calm and precise judgment, the insight to notice $$赤木$$'s poor physical condition when even $$いぶき$$ and $$青山$$ had not, and the leadership to keep Kokubouger's two sub-pilots in line.
He basically follows orders from his superiors faithfully, but he is a man of sound conscience who can put human life first. When Kokubouger was engulfed by a $$ヘテロダイン$$, he had his two sub-pilots evacuate regardless of danger to himself, fully aware he was disobeying orders. He also objected to a superior officer who wanted to use an OE weapon with $$ヘテロダイン$$ annihilation as the top priority, showing his deeply human side time and again.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 自身の危険を顧みずに means 'without regard for his own danger'; 'at his own risk' reads as accepting responsibility

303.DSCR:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 28 years old.
As the oldest woman on the section staff, her dependable personality makes her a good big-sister figure who keeps everyone together.
She is often seen fussing over the reckless $$赤木$$, but deep down she thinks of him as someone special.

304.DSCR:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 20 years old.
She excels at analyzing information and stays calm and collected no matter the situation, without so much as changing expression.
Yet she sometimes cracks jokes as if she were a completely different person, giving her an elusive, hard-to-pin-down personality.

305.DSCR:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 20 years old.
She loves gossip and talks a lot, which can make her seem flaky, but she is quick-witted and knows when to buckle down, making her quite reliable at heart.
Information she gets from a certain 'Ayumi in the Secretarial Section' is always at the center of her conversation.

307.DSCR:
Section chief of Public Relations Section 2. 48 years old.
A middle manager who spends his days with a knotted stomach over the actions of the $$ダイ・ガード$$ pilots, $$赤木$$ chief among them. But he is also the one who understands them best, and he somehow manages to deflect the pressure that comes from both the military and the company's executives.
Normally he plays the part of an unremarkable middle-aged man, but he is actually quite sharp. He was formerly a lieutenant in the $$国連$$ Volunteer Army, the predecessor of the Security Force, and served as a direct subordinate of then-Colonel $$大河内$$. From those days to the present, $$大河内$$'s trust in him has remained extremely deep.
The reason $$大河内$$ has deliberately kept such a trusted subordinate at the rank of section chief rather than promoting him to executive is simply that the position is a vital link between the field and the president.

308.DSCR:
Assistant section chief of Public Relations Section 2. 30 years old.
A hard worker who handles not only his main job of PR planning but also a wide range of tasks, from $$ダイ・ガード$$ maintenance to piloting transport aircraft and leading operations on the front line.
His love for his family runs deeper than most, and he dotes especially on his beloved daughter Mai, always carrying her photo with him.

309.DSCR:
In charge of clerical work for Public Relations Section 2. 27 years old.
During $$ダイ・ガード$$'s battles he stays behind at headquarters to provide backup, the unsung pillar of support behind the scenes.
He also acts as the de facto leader who keeps his fellow new hires $$伊集院$$ and $$田口$$ in line.

proofread.reason: pronoun: researched gender of 石塚 is male; 'she' is wrong

310.DSCR:
In charge of planning and production for Public Relations Section 2. 27 years old.
He is the same age as $$石塚$$ and $$伊集院$$, who joined the company in the same year, and he is often seen acting together with them.

311.DSCR:
In charge of domestic and overseas liaison for Public Relations Section 2. 27 years old.
He is known for a speaking style that mixes Japanese and English. He joined the company in the same year as $$石塚$$ and $$田口$$ from the same section.
He seems to have a thing for $$谷川$$, one of the female staff, and made moves on her such as inviting her on a hot spring trip. They did enjoy the trip once, but his wishy-washy attitude ended up angering her, and since then she has refused to have anything to do with him at all.

313.DSCR:
Chief of the $$ダイ・ガード$$ maintenance crew at $$２１世紀警備保障$$.
He gets along well with $$赤木$$, with whom he shares a certain rapport, and though foul-mouthed, his maintenance skills are the real thing. He constantly worked to bring $$ダイ・ガード$$ back to peak condition after it was damaged in fierce battles with the $$ヘテロダイン$$ or by $$赤木$$'s recklessness.
Because he develops equipment for $$ダイ・ガード$$, he has an inseparable relationship with the company's Technical Department, but at first he did not think much of its section chief, $$百目鬼$$. However, after seeing her true face when she happened to trip and fall, he fell for her at first sight, and from then on she often ordered him around, though perhaps out of being smitten he always seemed somehow pleased about it.

314.DSCR:
President of $$２１世紀警備保障$$. 57 years old.
Having personally experienced the terror of a $$ヘテロダイン$$ encounter in the past, he has dedicated his life to protecting people.
He is quiet and tough-looking, but his honest, caring personality has earned him deep trust within the company.
He once belonged to the $$国連$$ Volunteer Army, the predecessor of the Security Force, and lost his right eye in combat during that time. He still agonizes inwardly over his past decision to use an OE (Over Explosion) weapon against the first $$ヘテロダイン$$ to appear, twelve years ago.
In contrast to the Security Force, which treats $$ヘテロダイン$$ annihilation as the top priority without regard for collateral damage, he has invested his own principles in dealing with them through $$ダイ・ガード$$.

315.DSCR:
Secretary to the president of $$２１世紀警備保障$$.
A capable woman who supports President $$大河内$$ at his side.
She and $$赤木$$ are cousins, and they seem to have been close since childhood; it was also she who gave $$赤木$$ the push to join the company.

316.DSCR:
A tactical advisor dispatched to Public Relations Section 2 by the $$国連$$ Security Force.
He is an expert in operating upright special vehicles, and was dispatched to get the amateurish staff of Public Relations Section 2 to carry out operations swiftly.
He is an extremely serious, rigid stickler who always prioritizes orders and efficiency even in battle, believing that $$ヘテロダイン$$ annihilation came first even at the cost of some sacrifice. Because of this, when he was first dispatched he did not work well with the members of Public Relations Section 2, especially $$赤木$$, who acted from the citizens' point of view.
But as he witnessed $$赤木$$'s straightforward sense of justice and sincere actions firsthand, he too began to think about what really needed protecting, rather than pursuing efficiency alone. As a result, being fellow sports types, he and $$赤木$$ became a good team.
Beyond his skill at operating upright special vehicles and his tactical eye, he also shows real talent for the piloting technique he picked up while $$赤木$$ was injured. Later, when $$赤木$$ was absent, he confidently took over as main pilot and succeeded in disabling a $$ヘテロダイン$$.
Incidentally, since $$ダイ・ガード$$ is classified as a special vehicle, $$城田$$'s piloting it without a license technically constitutes driving without one.

317.DSCR:
An assistant tactical advisor dispatched by the Security Force under the pretense of strengthening cooperation with Public Relations Section 2.
He was apparently the most promising talent at the tactical research institute in London, and he has a correspondingly sharp mind.
He idolizes his senior $$城田$$, and took as his own tactical guideline the words $$城田$$ once taught him, that pursuing efficiency is what matters most. But he is also as stubborn and inflexible as $$城田$$ once was, and became someone who kept pushing unreasonable demands from the military and Nishijima onto Public Relations Section 2.
He was bitter about the way $$城田$$ had come to be influenced by Public Relations Section 2's style of fighting to protect something, and worked to disband the section, including trying to have the military select a new $$ダイ・ガード$$ pilot.
But that scheme ended in failure, and he too was moved by the passion of $$赤木$$ and the others, coming to be conscious of ways of fighting beyond mere efficiency, and grew to place his trust in them.

323.DSCR:
A fair-skinned man who works under $$ベック$$.
He is known for speaking with a flamboyant, effeminate manner.

324.DSCR:
A stocky man who works under $$ベック$$.
Together with $$ダヴ$$, he broke $$ベック$$ out of prison.

352.DSCR:
A student in $$陣代高校$$'s Class 2-4.
A girl known for her short haircut, she is on good terms with $$かなめ$$ and $$恭子$$.

361.DSCR:
A member of $$チームＤ$$, and the main pilot of the Nova Eagle and $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$.
Her catchphrase is 'Watch me pull this off!'
She is a racer who won three years running in F01, said to be the most extreme sport around, and also a top model active in billboard ads and more.
On the night she won the Shibuya Grand Prix for the third time, she is forcibly summoned to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$. Though furious at being forced to fight in the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ regardless of her wishes, she experiences a thrill unlike anything she has ever felt, and in the end signs a contract because of it.
Her creed is to always win what she wants through her own strength, and her drive to rise is extremely strong. She hates to lose and is passionate, and has had many lovers in the past. But none ever seem to last long, and even after deciding to join $$チームＤ$$ she went through a breakup with one man.
Once she learns the truth of the situation, she resolves without hesitation to head for the moon. Though she is nearly broken by the original Dancouga and almost succumbs to being haunted by her past as an abandoned child, she recovers thanks to the bonds with her comrades, and ultimately delivers the finishing blow to Moon $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ with her own fist.
What became of her after returning from the moon is unclear, but she has been seen riding off on her motorcycle.

362.DSCR:
A member of $$チームＤ$$ and the pilot of the Nova Liger.
Her catchphrase is 'I'll get this done!'
She is a narcotics investigator with the Metropolitan Police Department, and was teleported to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ just as she had captured the boss of an Asian drug syndicate. After experiencing combat in the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$, she accepted the scout's offer on the grounds that $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ seemed to hold more mysteries than any crime syndicate.
She excels at martial arts, reflexively throwing anyone who stands behind her. Her marksmanship is also first-rate, and $$ルゥ$$ Ririri often asked her for pointers. During $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s combination, she handles fire control, and it also falls to $$くらら$$ to pull the trigger on the Dankuu Cannon.
Perhaps because of a job that always keeps her close to death, she has the most mature outlook and thinking within the team, and a mental fortitude that does not flinch from danger. But she also shows a strangely childish side at times, such as delighting in $$葵$$'s extensive wardrobe or indulging in gun-shooting games in her private time.
When she heard $$ジョニー$$'s reason for joining the team, she pressed him on which of her and $$葵$$ he preferred, revealing a side of her that takes pride as a woman as well.
After $$チームＤ$$'s fight came to an end, she showed herself again to Chou, her old partner from her narcotics days.

364.DSCR:
A member of $$チームＤ$$ and the pilot of the Nova Elephant.
His catchphrase is 'I'll get it done, naturally.'
A top-flight sales rep once considered the leading candidate for the next company president, he was on his way to a meeting at the very moment he was teleported to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.
He subscribes to about thirty magazines a month whose titles all begin with 'A Man's...' - 'A Man's Cooking', 'A Man's Warships', 'A Man's Rod-and-Reel Fishing', 'A Man's Aircraft', and so on. This is because he is searching for what he truly wants to do, and his career as a salaryman is nothing more than a stopgap. The same goes for why he threw himself into the fighting - when he signed his contract, he called it a 'trial period'. He also shows interest in and skillfully handles anything he turns his hand to, be it work, cooking, or combat. During $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s combination, he is in charge of output control, handling it flawlessly.
He had always been somewhat conscious of $$エイーダ$$, who graced the cover of a magazine he subscribed to, but the two grow closer after meeting at a party held by Igor Konzern. When he learns she is the pilot of the R-Daigan, an enemy unit, he is shocked, but chooses to join hands with her as 'yesterday's enemy, today's friend'.
After defeating Moon $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ and restoring peace, he was seen enjoying shopping with $$エイーダ$$ in the city.

365.DSCR:
A national idol who climbed to her current status in barely a year since her debut.
She is active across many fields - major entertainment company Zolbrain's flagship games, commercials for Kerdonald Foods, and the cover of the magazine 'Monthly: A Man's Cooking', which $$ジョニー$$ himself subscribes to, among others.
She once lost out on a commercial appearance to $$ジョニー$$'s business skill, and since then took an interest in him, going so far as to gather information about him online. Eventually, at a party hosted by Igor Konzern, she meets $$ジョニー$$ in person, and the two grow drawn to each other.
Her true identity is the pilot of the R-Daigan.
Her catchphrase is 'I'm going to make this happen!'
Acting on $$ウラジミール$$'s orders, she repeatedly clashed with $$チームＤ$$. Eventually, right after she prompts the activation of the God Beast Mode, her assigned role, she is utterly beaten down, but her life is saved by $$ジョニー$$, who was quick to realize her true identity.
In the later battle against the Unknown, she shows outstanding teamwork with $$チームＤ$$, and when the team heads for the moon, she officially becomes one of its members.
After the final battle on the moon, with peace restored, she was seen enjoying shopping in the city with $$ジョニー$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says she urges/prompts the activation of the God Beast Mode (that is her role); the English reversed it so that she is the one being prompted

366.DSCR:
The founder and supreme director of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.
His public face is that of the president of $$イゴール・コンツェルン$$, a major entertainment conglomerate. Behind the scenes, he received backing from the leaders of nations in an international coalition and from mysterious billionaires, and built the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$.
His name is simply read as it is written, '$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$', but his real name is unknown. $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ is taken from the initials of 'Fog Sweeper', meaning 'one who clears away the fog'.
He once belonged to Hokkaido's Institute of Cognitive Science Brain Research, where he encountered $$ＷＩＬＬ$$, who had been damaged by a meteor impact. He agreed to cooperate with $$ＷＩＬＬ$$, and together they organized $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.

367.DSCR:
The commanding officer in charge of $$チームＤ$$.
He is mild-mannered and unassuming, always facing matters with a nonchalant, easygoing attitude.
He describes himself as nothing more than a middle manager within $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, and feigns ignorance whenever a conversation approaches the heart of the matter. But the sharp glint in his eyes and words that occasionally slip through hint at a shrewdness he keeps hidden.
He seems to have had his own private guesses about most things, including the purpose of the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$, and showed no particular surprise upon learning the truth.
When the existence of Moon $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ came to light, he initially opposed $$チームＤ$$'s deployment in line with $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s original plan, but in the end heads for the moon together with them.
What became of him after the fighting ended is unknown. Even his first name remained unknown to the very end.

368.DSCR:
The main computer of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$. Its name means 'will' or 'intent'.
At first its main role was to serve as an explainer in the command room, but gradually a great hidden secret began to come to light.
Its true nature is a self-aware machine, an inorganic intelligence, a being unlike any life on Earth.
In the distant past, there was a war between different civilizations that engulfed entire star systems. To prevent the same tragedy from repeating, it was created by the few surviving civilizations with the purpose of preemptively eliminating threats that might use advanced intelligence to wage war.
It viewed humanity as a dangerous existence, but also sensed in humanity's diversity and individual strength the possibility of a new path forward. When Moon $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ arrived anew, intent on destroying humanity based only on its present state, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ built the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ together with $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ as a means of resisting it.

369.DSCR:
$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s fourth-generation mental counselor. Fifteen years old.
Though young, she holds over one hundred licenses in psychiatry and psychology, and intensely dislikes being treated like a child. Incidentally, in Japan, where she lives, the age of adulthood is fifteen, and she insists at every opportunity that she is '15 years and 3 months old'.
She also dislikes having her name shortened to 'Ruriruri', and is put in a bad mood whenever someone calls her that.
Despite being a counselor, she is not good with men, and brings along a guard robot whenever she counsels $$ジョニー$$ or $$朔哉$$.
Beyond counseling, she is also skilled at piloting robots and the like.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the shortened form in the Japanese is Ruriruri, not her surname Riruri; 'Riruri' would not be a shortening of Ruu Riruri

370.DSCR:
$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s chief mechanic.
She is a humanist who shows equal affection not only to the machines but to the pilots who operate them.
She also has strong analytical skills and is reliable in many situations, but her one flaw is that she is a bad drunk. Once drunk, she loses all sense of gender boundaries, and has even pounced on $$葵$$.
As for machines, she does not just maintain them but also develops new weapons, and it was at $$朔哉$$'s request that she fitted the Boost Nova Knuckle.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says bad drinking habits (a bad drunk), not low tolerance; the Japanese verb means attacked/pounced on, not made a pass

371.DSCR:
The developer of the R-Daigan.
She is also the one who discovered and raised its pilot, $$エイーダ$$.
To secure funding, she has partnered with Zolbrain, a rival of $$イゴール・コンツェルン$$. She deftly manages the company president's wishes while keeping her own goals as his top priority.
She was once married to $$田中司令$$, and the two show a love-hate relationship, greeting each other with a slap followed by a kiss.
Incidentally, the design data for the R-Daigan was sent by $$ＷＩＬＬ$$; $$ウラジミール$$ did not build it entirely from scratch.

372.DSCR:
A journalist affiliated with BWC.
She harbors suspicions about the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s actions and existence, and is known as the 'combat correspondent' for flying into battlefields without regard for her own safety.
She won a Pulitzer Prize for her collected reporting, titled 'Is the Dancouga Necessary on the Battlefield?'
As she continues her activities, she comes under pressure from above, but holds firm to her conviction and keeps reporting regardless.
Eventually, her overreaching actions bring pressure down on the entire mass media industry, but she leaves her company rather than stop reporting. With information provided by $$朔哉$$, whom she met at a party hosted by $$イゴール・コンツェルン$$, she gradually closes in on the truth.
When $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ personally reveals the whole truth, she speaks as though she has given up on turning it into an article. But her resolve to keep covering the Dancouga as long as she lives never wavers, and she accompanies the team to the final battle on the moon, witnessing everything to the end.
After the fighting over the Dancouga came to an end, unable to suppress her journalistic instincts after all, she continued reporting on $$ＷＩＬＬ$$.
