384.DSCR:
A science bureau official of the New Government.
He once served as a lookout aboard $$ダイグレン$$, but now works a desk job; constant all-nighters have left him with permanent bags under his eyes. On top of that, his lack of exercise these days has left him considerably heavier.
When the $$大グレン団$$ members departed for space, he supported those around him as an operator, working as hard as ever.

proofread.reason: addition: 'them' and 'from behind the scenes' are not in the Japanese (supported those around him, as an operator, with unchanged effort)

387.DSCR:
The third-born of the 'Black Siblings,' known for her charming fang.
She met $$カミナ$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter. After joining $$大グレン団$$, she became a gunner on $$ダイグレン$$'s third bridge alongside $$キヨウ$$, and later piloted her own Gunmen, Kiyalunga, putting up a fight that put men to shame.

389.DSCR:
The second-born of the 'Black Siblings,' she met $$カミナ$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter.
Easygoing, shy, reserved, and earnest, her personality was unusual both among her siblings and within $$大グレン団$$, but she faced battle with the same fighting spirit as everyone else.
After the New Government was formed, she became secretary to Deputy Supreme Commander $$ロシウ$$. Her personality changed so much that she could be called cold, a change that surprised even her brother $$キタン$$.
Understanding the burden $$ロシウ$$ carries, she has given up everything to support him and carry out her duties.

402.DSCR:
A member of Section 1, Technology Division, Technical Development Department at the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$. Age 30.
A scientist in charge of the 'E Project,' whose goal is the development of the Evangelions.
She approaches everything with intellect and rationality. However, she can also be somewhat inflexible, and $$ミサト$$ describes her as 'someone who doesn't get jokes.' The same holds true on duty, where she often clashes with $$ミサト$$'s bold tactics.
Still, she and $$ミサト$$ have known each other since their school days, and despite their differences, they recognize each other as friends.

404.DSCR:
Vice Commander of the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
Someone who understands $$ゲンドウ$$, he assists him as an equal, and at times takes command of operations against the Angels in his place.
He rarely shows emotion, but upon seeing the site of the $$セカンドインパクト$$, he lets slip his true feelings: 'It's too painful to look at.'
In his free time, he can often be seen solving shogi puzzles.

405.DSCR:
A member of Section 1, Technology Division at the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
She assists $$リツコ$$, working on the 'E Project,' whose goal is the development of the Evangelions.

406.DSCR:
A member of Section 1, Operations Division at the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
An operator at Headquarters Operations Command, he assists $$ミサト$$ by analyzing the state of battle.

407.DSCR:
A member of Section 1, Intelligence Division, Investigation Department at the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
He handles communications and data analysis.

409.DSCR:
A student in Year 2 Class A at $$第３新東京市$$ Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
He always wears a tracksuit and speaks in a Kansai accent.
He and $$シンジ$$ start off on bad terms, as $$トウジ$$ lashes out in anger after his sister is injured when caught up in a battle, but the two reconcile after $$トウジ$$ witnesses $$シンジ$$ fighting the Angels with everything he has.
From then on, he and $$ケンスケ$$ become good friends with $$シンジ$$.

411.DSCR:
A student at the private $$アッシュフォード学園$$'s upper school. Age 18.
While serving as vice president of the student council, he also indulges in somewhat frivolous pastimes, such as playing chess for money. In truth, he was $$ルルーシュ$$ vi $$ブリタニア$$, the Eleventh Prince and Seventeenth Heir to the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$.
Having met the mysterious girl $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ during the Shinjuku Incident, $$ルルーシュ$$ received the $$ギアス$$ of 'Absolute Obedience' in exchange for granting her wish, and turned to rebel against the world. It was a rebellion meant to build a world where his beloved sister $$ナナリー$$ could live and smile.
Combining his brilliant mind and superb strategic eye with the power of $$ギアス$$, $$ルルーシュ$$ absorbed the resistance group of $$エリア１１$$ and formed the $$黒の騎士団$$. He steadily built up their strength until they could eventually fight $$ブリタニア$$ on equal terms.
However, during the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, the decisive battle for Japan's liberation, $$ナナリー$$, who was in a sense his very reason for fighting, was abducted, and he abandoned the battlefield. Searching for $$ナナリー$$, $$ルルーシュ$$ made his way to $$神根島$$, where he confronted his former best friend $$スザク$$. As a result, his identity was exposed, his existence denied, and he was dragged before the Emperor.
There, $$ルルーシュ$$ learned that his father $$シャルル$$ also wielded $$ギアス$$, and was struck by a $$ギアス$$ that rewrites memories, reverting him to the state before he became $$ゼロ$$, and further, into the memories of a mere nobleman's son.
In this way, $$ルルーシュ$$ forgot both that he had been $$ゼロ$$ and that he had ever had a sister named $$ナナリー$$, and lived a peaceful school life alongside his false brother, $$ロロ$$.
But after little more than a year, that peace came to a sudden end with the appearance of $$カレン$$ and $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
Regaining the memories that had been sealed by $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and becoming $$ゼロ$$ once more, $$ルルーシュ$$ used a series of schemes to found the $$超合集国$$, a coalition to rival $$ブリタニア$$.
Yet in the course of the fighting, $$ルルーシュ$$ lost $$シャーリー$$, lost $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ (who lost her memories and was no longer the $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ he had known), and lost $$ナナリー$$, and $$シュナイゼル$$'s scheming cost him even his place within the $$黒の騎士団$$; in the midst of fleeing, he lost $$ロロ$$ as well.
Having lost everything, $$ルルーシュ$$ resolved never to return and entered the World of C, where he confronted his father and the mother he had believed dead. Told by his parents of their plan to merge all of humanity's consciousness into one, he rejected it outright, and together with a $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ who had regained her memories, erased both his father and mother from existence.
He then ascended to the throne as Emperor of $$ブリタニア$$, standing as the enemy of the world against the $$黒の騎士団$$ and his beloved sister $$ナナリー$$.
Having won the final battle against $$シュナイゼル$$ and the $$黒の騎士団$$, $$ルルーシュ$$ finally seized control of the world. But he was then struck down by $$ゼロ$$, who appeared before him, in truth $$スザク$$ in disguise.
It was all part of a scheme devised by $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$スザク$$, who both wished for a better tomorrow, along with their collaborators. This $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ was completed with $$ルルーシュ$$'s death, and the world entered a new era.

412.DSCR:
The masked persona $$ルルーシュ$$ adopted to hide his true identity.
He first appeared before the public to rescue $$スザク$$, who had been accused of assassinating Clovis, and from then on staged one miracle after another, becoming a symbol of resistance against $$ブリタニア$$.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, $$ゼロ$$ vanished for nearly a year while $$ルルーシュ$$'s memories were sealed, but when $$ルルーシュ$$'s memories returned, so did $$ゼロ$$, appearing before the people once more.
From then on, he pulled off even greater feats, single-handedly rescuing comrades about to be executed, arranging for a million Japanese people to go into exile in the $$中華連邦$$, and founding the $$超合集国$$, and became a leading figure of the anti-Britannia movement.
However, $$シュナイゼル$$'s scheming exposed both $$ギアス$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$'s true identity, forcing a break with the Black Knights.
But $$ゼロ$$ appeared once more and struck down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, who had by then seized control of the world. In truth, this $$ゼロ$$ was $$スザク$$, who had plotted the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ together with $$ルルーシュ$$: by having $$ゼロ$$ strike down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, all the hatred concentrated upon the Emperor vanished, and the world entered a new era.
From then on, $$スザク$$ carried on $$ルルーシュ$$'s will, devoting the rest of his life to being $$ゼロ$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: mistranslation: 百万人の日本人を中華連邦へと亡命させた - Zero had them flee into exile; he did not grant asylum (the Federation would)

413.DSCR:
The son of Genbu Kururugi, the last Prime Minister of Japan, and $$ルルーシュ$$'s childhood friend. Age 18.
He killed his own father, Genbu, in an attempt to end the war between Japan and $$ブリタニア$$. Wracked with guilt, he sought out death by enlisting in the Britannian military, fighting to change $$ブリタニア$$ from within. But upon learning that his sworn enemy $$ゼロ$$ was in truth his best friend $$ルルーシュ$$, he captured $$ルルーシュ$$, who had abandoned the battlefield during the Black Rebellion, on $$神根島$$.
By handing $$ルルーシュ$$ over to Emperor $$シャルル$$, he earned the position of $$ナイトオブセブン$$ among the Emperor's personal Knights of the Round.
After $$ユーフェミア$$'s death and $$ルルーシュ$$'s betrayal, his sense of responsibility and strength of will grew even stronger, and he began making cold, ruthless decisions in the field.
Upon hearing news of $$ゼロ$$'s return, he is posted to $$エリア１１$$ to assist the new Viceroy, $$ナナリー$$. He re-enrolls at $$アッシュフォード学園$$ to investigate $$ルルーシュ$$, but has trouble pinning down his true identity, since $$ルルーシュ$$ has already co-opted the intelligence bureau.
As $$ルルーシュ$$ lost allies one after another in the fighting, he finally admitted to $$スザク$$ that he was $$ゼロ$$ and asked for his help in protecting $$ナナリー$$. The two nearly joined forces, but $$シュナイゼル$$'s scheming and a resulting misunderstanding drove them apart once more.
During the $$第二次トウキョウ決戦$$, cornered by $$カレン$$'s $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$, the 'Live' $$ギアス$$ $$ルルーシュ$$ had once placed on him activates, and in self-defense he fires the tactical weapon Freya, mounted on the Lancelot. Having taken countless lives through his own actions, $$スザク$$ abandons kindness and begins pursuing results alone.
He joins $$シュナイゼル$$'s coup in order to become $$ナイト$$ of One. Heading to $$神根島$$ to assassinate $$シャルル$$, $$スザク$$ there learns $$ルルーシュ$$'s true intentions. Becoming his collaborator, he begins calling himself $$ナイトオブゼロ$$, sworn to $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.
In the final battle, he fights $$カレン$$'s $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$ to a mutual standstill. Afterward, he casts aside his life as $$枢木スザク$$, and becomes $$ゼロ$$ to complete the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$, striking down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.

414.DSCR:
Born to a Britannian noble father and a Japanese mother, she has been a member of the $$黒の騎士団$$ since its founding. Age 18.
Energetic and unwilling to lose, she harbors deep anger toward $$ブリタニア$$ for conquering her homeland, Japan.
She met $$ゼロ$$ during her time in the resistance, and after witnessing the many miracles he brought about, came to trust him more and more. Her exceptional skill piloting Knightmare Frames was soon recognized, and after the $$黒の騎士団$$ were formed, she was appointed captain of the $$ゼロ$$ Squad, $$ゼロ$$'s personal guard. Piloting her crimson signature unit, the Guren Type-02, she charged through the front lines as the $$黒の騎士団$$' ace.
During the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, she pursued the $$ランスロット$$ to $$神根島$$, where she learned that $$ゼロ$$'s true identity was $$ルルーシュ$$. She fell into a state of shock for a time, effectively abandoning $$ルルーシュ$$, but her trust in $$ゼロ$$ never fully disappeared.
After a year in hiding, she carried out Operation Hien $$フォウ$$ with $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and others to confirm both her own feelings and $$ルルーシュ$$'s true intentions, and succeeded in reviving $$ゼロ$$.
From then on, with skill said to rival that of the Knights of the Round and her beloved Guren, she won victory after victory on the battlefield, but was captured after running out of energy in her fight against $$星刻$$.
Taken prisoner, $$カレン$$ was handed over to $$スザク$$, and remained off the battlefield for a long time until $$咲世子$$ rescued her during the $$第二次トウキョウ決戦$$.
When $$ゼロ$$, having been driven out of the $$黒の騎士団$$, became $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, she reunited with him at a negotiation and gave him a farewell kiss.
In the final battle, she fought $$スザク$$ to a near-mutual defeat, but ultimately claimed victory. Afterward, though condemned to execution as a traitor, $$カレン$$ witnessed the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ unfold before her eyes.
Having come to understand the true intentions of both $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$スザク$$, $$カレン$$ went on to live in the new world $$ルルーシュ$$ had wished for.

proofread.reason: mistranslation (grammar/referent): grammar/meaning: plural subject 'she and her Guren' with 'was captured' made the Guren the one captured; the Japanese subject of 捕縛されてしまう is Kallen alone

415.DSCR:
A girl who possesses an immortal body and the 'Code,' a power that grants $$ギアス$$.
Her name, written '$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$,' is pronounced 'C-Two.'
Under a contract to have her own wish fulfilled, she gave $$ルルーシュ$$ the $$ギアス$$ of 'Absolute Obedience' as the price.
During the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, she sinks $$ジェレミア$$'s $$ジークフリート$$ into the sea, prepared for mutual destruction, and escapes. She then goes into hiding to evade pursuit, but a year later, she carries out Operation Hien $$フォウ$$ with $$カレン$$ and others to reclaim $$ゼロ$$, awakening $$ルルーシュ$$'s sealed memories and reviving him as $$ゼロ$$.
The one wish stipulated by their contract was for her to pass on the immortal Code to someone else so that she herself could finally die. She lent $$ルルーシュ$$ her aid only to wait for his $$ギアス$$ to grow strong enough to reach that point.
Before $$ルルーシュ$$ could earn that qualification, $$シャルル$$ offered to grant her wish himself, but $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ refused. To protect $$ルルーシュ$$, and to fulfill her true wish, she sealed away the immortal Code along with her own memories.
Having lost her memories, she reverted to the state she was in before receiving $$ギアス$$, but was revived after being persuaded by $$マリアンヌ$$, who had been hiding within $$アーニャ$$, and went with her to $$神根島$$. There, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ watched the entire confrontation between $$シャルル$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$ unfold, and in the end rejected $$シャルル$$ and the others.
Afterward, she remained at the side of $$ルルーシュ$$, now Emperor, as his shield, and took part in the final battle as well.
Having witnessed the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ through to the end, she set off for parts unknown, carrying with her the memories of her fellow conspirator, $$ルルーシュ$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation (reversed direction): reversed direction: 自らの望みを叶えるという契約 is C.C. having her wish granted (by Lelouch), not C.C. granting her own wish; その対価として = 'as its price'

417.DSCR:
A Britannian military officer from the prestigious Gottwald family, bearing the title of Margrave. Age 29.
As leader of the 'Purist Faction,' which held that the Britannian military should be made up of ethnic Britannians only, he plotted to seize control of the army, but was brought down by $$ゼロ$$'s schemes. The scandal $$ゼロ$$ fabricated at the time, 'Orange,' left him scorned by that nickname ever after.
Later, in a bid to turn his fortunes around, he was struck by the Guren Type-02's radiant wave surger during the battle of the Narita mountains, and while wandering near death was recovered by researchers under $$バトレー$$. His body was then modified to serve as a test subject.
He awakened in an unstable state during the $$ブラックリベリオン$$. His obsession with $$ゼロ$$ spiraled out of control, and he confronted $$ゼロ$$ while piloting the $$ジークフリート$$, but sank into the sea alongside the $$ガウェイン$$, piloted by $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
Afterward, the $$ギアス嚮団$$ recovered him along with the $$ジークフリート$$. Further modifications gave him the power of the '$$ギアス$$ Canceller,' capable of nullifying $$ギアス$$. He used this power to corner $$ルルーシュ$$, but his true aim was to confirm $$ルルーシュ$$'s real intentions. Despite the repeated modifications, $$ジェレミア$$'s loyalty to the imperial family never faded, and he swore his allegiance to $$ルルーシュ$$, son of the beloved Empress Marianne.
From then on, he fought hard as $$ルルーシュ$$'s loyal subordinate, continuing even after $$ルルーシュ$$ ascended to the throne as Emperor.
After the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ was completed, he took up running an orange farm. By his side was $$アーニャ$$, once his enemy in battle.

418.DSCR:
$$ルルーシュ$$'s younger sister, and 87th in line for the Britannian throne. 15 years old.
She was present when their mother $$マリアンヌ$$ was assassinated and was caught in the crossfire, losing the sight of both eyes and the use of both legs.
She was the very reason $$ルルーシュ$$ fought, but after the $$ブラックリベリオン$$ her whereabouts became unknown.
After $$ゼロ$$'s return, however, she appeared before $$ルルーシュ$$ again as an imperial princess of $$ブリタニア$$ and the new Viceroy of $$エリア１１$$.
Once installed as Viceroy, she held to the conviction that the world could be changed for the gentler, and kept searching for a way for people of different races and values to walk the same path together.
During the $$第二次トウキョウ決戦$$ she was swallowed by the Freya's explosion and went missing, only to reappear as an empress on Schneizel's side, standing in $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s way.
At the final battle she resolved to take the sin upon herself and grasped the control switch for the Freya warhead. Her strong will broke through even her father $$シャルル$$'s memory-rewriting $$ギアス$$.
Afterward, moments before her execution as a traitor, she witnessed the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ unfold before her eyes. Understanding her brother's true intent at last, $$ナナリー$$ clung to his body and wept as the crowd's voices rose in praise of $$ゼロ$$, the hero who had struck down the evil $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.

proofread.reason: addition; mistranslation: addition: 'puppet' is not in シュナイゼル側の皇帝; mistranslation: 父シャルルの記憶を書き換えるギアス is Charles's Geass that rewrites memories, not a Geass that rewrote Charles's memory

421.DSCR:
One of the Knights of the Round, the strongest knights of the Empire -- $$ナイト$$ of Three. 17 years old.
Though born into an illustrious noble family, he earned the rank of $$ナイト$$ of Three on his own merit.
He is cheerful, easygoing, and looks out for others. After his transfer to $$エリア１１$$ he showed off his boundless curiosity by transferring into $$アッシュフォード学園$$ alongside $$アーニャ$$.
He took a strong interest in $$カレン$$ after meeting her on the battlefield, and when she was taken prisoner he invited her to take a Britannian name.
When $$ルルーシュ$$ eventually became Emperor of $$ブリタニア$$ and $$スザク$$ became his knight, $$ジノ$$ turned against them. He briefly lost sight of why he fought, but resolved to fight $$ルルーシュ$$ and took part in the final battle.
There, wielding the $$トリスタン・ディバイダー$$ equipped with the Excalibur that Bismarck had left behind, he let $$ルルーシュ$$ escape but destroyed his mount, the $$蜃気楼$$.

422.DSCR:
One of the Knights of the Round, the strongest knights of the Empire -- $$ナイト$$ of Six. 15 years old.
A formidable talent who rose to the rank of Rounds $$ナイト$$ at the youngest age on record. She rarely shows emotion and behaves with a detached calm, though on rare occasions she does things that defy common sense.
She always carries a cell phone and photographs everything she calls a 'memory,' but this was in fact a way of filling in the memories she lost each time $$マリアンヌ$$ -- $$ルルーシュ$$'s mother, who had entered her mind through a $$ギアス$$ that transfers others' consciousness -- awakened within her. These lost memories never returned even after $$マリアンヌ$$ was erased.
At the final battle she fought $$ジェレミア$$ as part of $$シュナイゼル$$'s forces and destroyed his Sutherland Sieg, but was defeated by the self-destruct attack of the Sutherland J that emerged from within it. From their exchange, $$ジェレミア$$ realized some kind of $$ギアス$$ had been placed on $$アーニャ$$, and his $$ギアス$$ Canceller freed her completely from $$マリアンヌ$$.
After the final battle, she was seen at the side of $$ジェレミア$$, who worked at the orange farm.

proofread.reason: pronoun/referent: referent: オレンジ農園で働くジェレミアの傍ら - it is Jeremiah who works at the farm (agrees with pilot 417), not Anya

423.DSCR:
Leader of the '$$扇$$ Group,' a resistance organization that once operated around the Tokyo Settlement, and vice commander of the $$黒の騎士団$$. 27 years old.
He sheltered the amnesiac Villetta Nu, naming her Chigusa and caring for her, and in doing so came to hold special feelings for her. Those feelings did not fade even after Villetta, having regained her memory during the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, shot him.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$ he was held by $$ブリタニア$$ for over a year, but was rescued along with the other $$黒の騎士団$$ members by the returned $$ゼロ$$. He served once more as vice commander of the $$黒の騎士団$$ under $$ゼロ$$, and as Secretary-General of the $$超合集国$$ forces.
Even during their long separation $$扇$$'s feelings for Villetta never disappeared, and when she told him the truth about $$ゼロ$$'s identity and his $$ギアス$$, $$扇$$ realized that to $$ゼロ$$ they were nothing more than pawns, and chose to part ways with him.
After the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$, he married Villetta and became Prime Minister of a Japan independent from $$ブリタニア$$.

425.DSCR:
An engineer from the $$中華連邦$$'s Indian Military District. 29 years old.
She once studied abroad in $$ブリタニア$$, where she was a contemporary of $$ロイド$$ and $$セシル$$, but she dislikes $$ロイド$$ and calls him 'Earl Pudding.' According to $$セシル$$, though, the reason the two of them are always at each other's throats seems to be something rather trivial.
She developed $$黒の騎士団$$ KMFs such as the Guren Type-02 and the Gekka, but after the $$ブラックリベリオン$$ she went into hiding in the $$中華連邦$$ along with Diethard and the others. When she learned that $$ゼロ$$ had returned, she rejoined the $$黒の騎士団$$.
Afterward she deployed the Guren Kashoshiki, Zangetsu, and Akatsuki in succession, and served as Minister of Science within the $$超合集国$$ forces.

426.DSCR:
A maid dispatched by the Ashford family to look after $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$ナナリー$$, and an Honorary Britannian. 25 years old.
In truth she is the 37th head of the Shinozaki School of bodyguards, and secretly a member of the $$黒の騎士団$$.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$ she went into hiding in the $$中華連邦$$ with Diethard and the others, but on learning of $$ゼロ$$'s return she rejoined the $$黒の騎士団$$. From then on she mainly worked as $$ルルーシュ$$'s body double, though her natural airheadedness often threw situations into confusion.
At the $$第二次トウキョウ決戦$$ she infiltrated the government headquarters to seize $$ナナリー$$, now Viceroy. She succeeded in rescuing the captive $$カレン$$, but failed to recapture $$ナナリー$$.
Afterward she went missing for a long time, but eventually rushed to $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s side and continued to support him to the very end. $$ジェレミア$$, in a similar position himself, called her devotion in following the master she had chosen, $$ルルーシュ$$, despite being Japanese, a form of chivalry.

A mysterious creature that stays with $$ミコノ$$.
$$ミコノ$$ calls it a 'cat,' though $$アマタ$$ has his doubts.
Normally it takes the shape of a ribbon-like ornament in $$ミコノ$$'s hair or on her shoulder, but it reacts in various ways depending on $$ミコノ$$'s emotions.
It has a jealous streak, and tends to threaten or bite people $$ミコノ$$ is especially close to, such as $$アマタ$$ and $$ユノハ$$.
